strategy: Complete geographically connected clusters before opening isolated metros.

activeCluster.name: Tucson and Tulsa anchor connector
activeCluster.reason: Upgrade four existing launch records across Tucson and Tulsa, pairing two high-value Sun Belt metros with strong family, garden, river-trail, and flagship-park search demand.
activeCluster.releaseStandard: Four licensed destination-specific photos, preserved official visitor answers, full street addresses, static canonical pages, and only subsites with reviewed coordinates plus destination-specific licensed photography.

completed: Campaign definition and package commands validate.
Openverse research collected 91 reusable-license candidates: 21 for Gene C. Reid Park, 26 for Rillito River Park, 29 for Gathering Place, and 15 for Woodward Park.
Boundary research completed: one candidate for Gene C. Reid Park, none for the linear Rillito River Park, five for Gathering Place, and one for Woodward Park.
resumeCheckpoint.nextAction: Restart nearby-feature research, then visually curate four destination-specific photos per releasable parent before selecting boundaries, coordinates, addresses, and subsites.

Zorinsky Lake Park needs three current, reusable views representing the lake, trail, and a visitor amenity.
Sedgwick County Park needs permission-cleared park, playscape, lake, trail, and shelter images; unrelated search results are not acceptable substitutes.

Kathryn Albertson Park needs three current reusable broad views representing its ponds, loop, shelters, wildlife habitat, and visitor experience.
